Your granddaughter Elif Yilmaz would love to know what school was like when you were young.

segments.speaker: center
segments.transcript: Oh games, we didn't have toys like children today. We play hopstrack in the dirt roads in front of our house. My friends are here and I drive to squares with a stick.

segments.speaker: companion

That sounds like such fun, playing hopscotch on the dirt roads and driving to squares with a stick.

segments.speaker: center
segments.transcript: And they play Five Stones, you draw one.

segments.speaker: companion

segments.speaker: center
segments.transcript: In the evenings, all the children play hide and seek and the big mob were there. My mother would call us home when it got dark and our feet were always purple from the berries.

segments.speaker: companion
segments.transcript:

segments.speaker: center
segments.transcript: Let me tell you about my wedding. I married your grandfather in the spring of 1971. I left the wedding today.

segments.speaker: companion
